verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official CLI. The docs show the full scaffold-and-run flow (`npx sv create myapp`, `npm install`, `npm run dev`) and call `npx sv create` the easiest way to start a SvelteKit app. The CLI offers templates such as a library template, lets you choose a package manager, can create a project from a playground URL, and runs on a Vite dev server with instant reload. A community report also praises the easy getting-started instructions. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that setup actually takes only a few minutes.
